blocks.text: Databases woh zaroori data rakhte hain jo application chalane ke liye chahiye, aur applications ko bare data sets achhi tarah sambhalne dete hain. Database ke aham concepts yeh hain:

items: Relational Database: aisa database jo data tables (rows aur columns) mein rakhta hai aur tables ko relationships se jorta hai.
Table: mutalliq data ka majmua jo rows (records) aur columns (fields) mein munazzam hota hai (Figure 4.3).
Column: entity ki koi khusoosiyat (maslan name, age).
Primary Key: table ke har record ki alag (unique) pehchan.
Foreign Key: aisi field jo doosre table ki primary key ka hawala de kar aik table ko doosre se jorti hai.

blocks.alt: Do tables. Table: Student ke columns RollNo, Name, Age, DeptID; rows 101 Kiran 20 1; 102 Ibrahim 21 2; 103 M Kamal 20 1; 104 Zainab 22 3. Table: Department ke columns DeptID, DeptName; rows 1 Computer Science; 2 Electronics; 3 Mechanical. Nishanat: Column (Attribute), Field (Attribute Value), Record (Tuple), RollNo aur Department DeptID ke neeche Primary Key, aur Student DeptID se Department ki primary key tak lakeer par Foreign Key.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.3: Tables, columns, records, fields, primary key aur foreign key ka rishta (kitab ki Figure 4.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Primary key aur foreign key mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Primary key apne table ke har record ki munfarid pehchan hai (jaise RollNo); foreign key aik table ki field hai jo tables jorne ke liye doosre table ki primary key rakhti hai (jaise Student mein DeptID).

blocks.text: Figure 4.3 ke do tables Python mein: Student table aik list hai jis ki har row aik dictionary (record) hai, aur Department table aik dictionary. roll_no badal kar Run karein: primary key se record milta hai aur foreign key (DeptID) se doosre table ka department.

roll_no = 102   # Student table mein dhoondne wala RollNo (primary key)

students = [
    {"RollNo": 101, "Name": "Kiran", "Age": 20, "DeptID": 1},
    {"RollNo": 102, "Name": "Ibrahim", "Age": 21, "DeptID": 2},
    {"RollNo": 103, "Name": "M Kamal", "Age": 20, "DeptID": 1},
    {"RollNo": 104, "Name": "Zainab", "Age": 22, "DeptID": 3},
]
departments = {1: "Computer Science", 2: "Electronics", 3: "Mechanical"}

found = False
for record in students:
    if record["RollNo"] == roll_no:
        print("Record:", record)
        dept = departments[record["DeptID"]]   # foreign key se Department table tak
        print(record["Name"], "ka department:", dept)
        found = True
if not found:
    print("Is RollNo ka koi record nahi")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"roll_no = 102": jis student ko dhoondna hai us ka RollNo; yeh primary key hai, is liye har student ka alag hai.
"students = [...]": Student table: har row aik record hai, aur "RollNo", "Name", "Age", "DeptID" columns (fields) hain.
"departments = {1: "Computer Science", ...}": Department table: DeptID (is table ki primary key) se department ka naam.
"for record in students:" aur "if record["RollNo"] == roll_no:": har row dekh kar woh record dhoondta hai jis ka RollNo barabar ho.
"departments[record["DeptID"]]": student ki DeptID (foreign key) se Department table mein naam nikalta hai.
"if not found:": koi record na mile to yeh paigham.
Output: "Record: {'RollNo': 102, 'Name': 'Ibrahim', 'Age': 21, 'DeptID': 2}" aur "Ibrahim ka department: Electronics".
Khud try karein: roll_no = 104 par "Zainab ka department: Mechanical" aayega; roll_no = 110 par "Is RollNo ka koi record nahi".

items: Relational database: tables (rows = records, columns = fields).
Primary key har record ki pehchan; foreign key doosre table ki primary key se jorti hai.
